hooks.command: command -v powershell >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -WindowStyle Hidden -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/scripts/auto-save-progress.ps1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

input=$(cat); command -v powershell >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; printf '%s' "$input" | powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -WindowStyle Hidden -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/scripts/detect-stuck.ps1"

input=$(cat); case "$input" in *_script.txt*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; command -v powershell >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; printf '%s' "$input" | powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -WindowStyle Hidden -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/scripts/check-lesson-order.ps1"
